# Extracurricular API documentation

Reference for API version **v1**. Everything here is generated from the same code that
produces the JSON, so it always matches what the API returns.

| Page | What's in it |
|---|---|
| [Endpoints](endpoints.md) | Every URL you can request, with examples |
| [Filters](filters.md) | The five filter segments and every value they accept |
| [Responses](responses.md) | The envelope every response is wrapped in, endpoint by endpoint |
| [Fields](fields.md) | Every field of an activity: type, allowed values, meaning |
| [Versions](versions.md) | How versioning and deprecation work, and every version so far |
| Schools | [Queen's University](schools/queens.md) (`queens`) |

The same information is available as JSON from the API itself:

| Human docs | JSON equivalent |
|---|---|
| Endpoints | `v1/index.json` |
| Filters, faculties, sources | `v1/{school}/info.json` |
| Tags | `v1/{school}/tags.json` |
| Versions | `versions.json` |
| Fields | [`contracts/v1.json`](../contracts/v1.json) in this repository (machine-readable contract) |

**Rule of thumb:** `null` always means *unknown*. Nothing in this API is guessed.

**Privacy:** the API collects nothing about you (no cookies, analytics or keys), and publishes only
club-level information. See `privacy.html` on the site for details, including how to request a
correction or removal.
